item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot and generally fine weather to Guangdong this week. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will be isolated showers over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 10/07 (Monday)
Wind: Southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine and very hot apart from isolated showers.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
